accountsIntro: Add your email account to start reading mail.
passwordKeep: Leave blank to keep the saved password.
passwordAppNote: Gmail and Outlook need an app password when two-factor authentication is on.
deleteAccountConfirm: Delete this account and its cached mail? The mail stays on the server.
subject: Subject
sentCopyWarning: Sent, but the copy could not be saved.
deliveryUnknown: {count, plural, one {# message has an unknown delivery state} other {# messages have an unknown delivery state}}
deliveryUnknownDetail: Shu did not resend automatically, to avoid sending twice.
shortcutsHint: J / K move · E archive · S star · U unread · R reply
selectedCount: {count, plural, one {# message selected} other {# messages selected}}
aiIntro: Bring your own key. Mail text goes straight from this device to the provider you choose, and only when you press an AI button. Shu has no servers.
aiKeyReplace: Type a new key to replace the stored one
aiKeyStored: A key is stored in the system keychain. It is never shown.
aiKeyOptional: This kind of server usually needs no key.
aiHTTPWarning: This server uses plain HTTP. Mail text and your key would cross the network unencrypted.
aiAllowHTTP: Allow plain HTTP to this server
aiSummariesDetail: Summarize the open message or conversation. Sends the subject, the senders' names and dates, and up to {limit} characters of a message's text, {conversationLimit} for a whole conversation.
aiTriageDetail: Suggest what needs you, what can wait and what can be archived. Sends the sender, subject and a short preview of up to {count} listed messages.
aiDraftsDetail: Write an editable reply in the compose window. Sends the same excerpt as a summary, plus your guidance.
aiNeverSent: Never sent: quoted replies, signatures, link addresses, attachments and other recipients. You review the exact text the first time you use each capability.
aiGenerated: Written by {model}. Check the original before acting on it.
aiOff: AI features are off. Turn them on in Settings and add your own key; nothing is sent until you do.
aiFeatureOff: This AI capability is turned off in Settings.
aiNoKey: No API key is stored for the provider. Add one in Settings.
aiNoModel: No model is chosen. Pick one in Settings.
aiErrInvalidKey: The provider rejected the API key.
aiErrRateLimit: The provider's rate limit was reached. Try again in a moment.
aiErrTimeout: The model took too long to answer.
aiErrUnreachable: The server could not be reached.
aiErrModel: The provider does not offer this model.
aiErrInsecure: The server uses plain HTTP, which is refused unless you allow it in Settings.
aiErrServer: The provider answered with an error (HTTP {status}).
aiErrBadResponse: The model's answer could not be read.
aiErrEmpty: This message has no text to send.
aiErrConfig: The provider settings are not valid.
aiErrKeychain: The system keychain is not available.

aiReviewLinks: {count, plural, one {# link address} other {# link addresses}}
aiReviewAlways: Attachments, recipients and other headers are never sent.
aiReviewTruncated: The body was cut at the limit.
aiReviewOnce: You will not be asked again for this capability; what is sent stays inspectable.

aiTriageNote: Suggestions only: nothing moves until you move it.

@discardDraftTitle.description: The title of the confirmation before drafts are deleted.

discardDraftConfirm: It is deleted from this device and from the Drafts folder on the server. You can't undo this.
draftNotSent: A draft on this device. It has not been sent.
draftOnServer: A draft from the server's Drafts folder, written in another mail client.
draftOffline: Saved on this device · will sync when online
draftLocalOnly: Saved on this device only · the server has no Drafts folder
draftConflict: This draft was changed in another mail client. Your version was kept as a separate draft.

draftUploadsLater: Saved on this device · uploads on close or sync

@attachFilesTip.description: The tooltip of the button that attaches files, with its keyboard shortcut.

@removeAttachment.description: The button that takes one attached file off the message.

@attachmentsTotal.description: How many files are attached and their size together.

attachmentsWarning: This message will be about {size} when sent. Mail servers often refuse messages over {limit}, so it may not go through.

@attachmentsWarning.description: A warning, not an error: the server decides. size is the message as encoded for sending.

@draftUploadsLater.description: The status of a draft with large attachments: it is not uploaded at every pause in the typing, only when its window closes or the account syncs.

attachBusy: Wait until the files are attached, then send.
attachFolder: “{name}” is a folder. Only files can be attached.
attachMissing: “{name}” could not be found. It may have been moved or deleted.
attachDenied: Shu is not allowed to read “{name}”.
attachTooLarge: “{name}” was not attached: a message can carry at most {limit} of attachments.

@sendProgress.description: How much of a message with attachments has gone to the server.

sendFinishing: Waiting for the server to accept the message…
sendCancelled: Sending was cancelled. Nothing was sent; the draft and its attachments are still here.
sendCancelledUnknown: Sending was cancelled while the message was on its way. It was most likely not delivered, but Shu cannot be sure, and will not send it again on its own. The draft and its attachments are still here.
sendInterrupted: The connection was lost while the message was on its way, so Shu cannot tell whether it was delivered, and will not send it again on its own. The draft and its attachments are still here. ({error})

@sendRejected.description: reply is the mail server's own answer.

sendRejectedSize: The server refused the message as too large: {reply}. Nothing was sent. Remove an attachment and send again.

@sendRejectedSize.description: reply is the mail server's own answer.

sendOverLimit: This message is {size}, and the server accepts at most {limit}. Nothing was sent. Remove an attachment and send again.
sendAttachmentMissing: An attached file is no longer on this device, so nothing was sent. Remove it and attach it again.

@newMailCount.description: The text of a notification that says how many messages arrived, under the account's name.

@watchCheckedAt.description: The sidebar footer: mail was last checked at this time, written as the message list writes times.

watchRetryNetwork: Can't reach the mail server. Trying again soon.
watchRetryAuth: The mail server refused the sign-in. Trying again later.
watchRetryOther: Couldn't check for mail. Trying again soon.
watchOffline: Offline. Mail is checked once you're back online.

checkEveryDetail: Mail servers that can push deliver new mail right away. Folders and unread counts, and servers that can't push, are checked this often.
notifyNewMailDetail: Shown as system notifications, which follow Do Not Disturb and Focus.
notifyDetailsDetail: When off, a notification only says which account got how many new messages.
notifyDenied: Notifications are turned off for Shu in the system's settings.

oauthNamePlaceholder: Shown on the mail you send
manualSetup: Or set up manually with a password

signInWaitingAs: Sign in to {provider} as {email} on the page Shu opened. Shu goes on by itself once you're done.
